notes: Cognitive walkthrough (full four-question variant) of journey book-a-slot at 375 px, light theme. Record: runs/20261016-125610-audit-standard/cw/book-a-slot.json. 8 steps walked, 4 failed (steps 1, 2, 4, 8), overall would_with_effort. All candidates are E0 hypotheses. The journeys.json _comment names a ground-truth file; it was not opened. Other agents' probe directories were not read. No bboxes were measured, so none are given.

task_suitability.evidence: probes/20 (the defined sequence replays to 'Show this at the gate'); the walker knew the path, so this is not predicted user success

strengths.title: Check-and-book summary restates day, 20-minute window, vehicle and waste with change links, so a first-time resident can check the booking before committing
Day shortcuts use residents' words ('Saturday 17', 'Tomorrow') and slots use plain 24-hour times

candidates.title: Slots area stays blank with no loading message after a day is chosen
candidates.description: After choosing a day, a resident should see at once that slots are being fetched. On / at 375 px, after tapping 'Saturday 17' the 'Slots' region shows only its heading and empty paragraphs at 0, 300 and 500 ms, with no loading text or indicator; the slot list appears by about 1 s. On first load 'Today' is already pressed while the same region is empty.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident, who does not know that slots take a moment to appear, may read the empty area as 'no slots on Saturday' and switch day or leave.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: click Saturday 17; screenshots t0 and t500 show empty Slots area; t3000 shows 22 slots
ARIA 300 ms after click: Slots region has heading, two empty paragraphs, empty group
initial state: Today pressed, Slots empty

factor_notes.frequency: Every day choice on the first step of every booking.
factor_notes.impact: Ambiguous empty state on the scarce resource; persona explicitly does not know slots load with a delay.
factor_notes.persistence: Learned after one booking, but bookings happen a few times a year.

candidates.recommendation: Show a short 'Finding free slots for Saturday 17 October…' message in the Slots area while loading, announced politely.

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots shown in a separate unlabelled block above 'Morning', out of time order
candidates.description: A time picker for one day should read in time order so a resident can scan to the part of the day they want. On / after choosing Saturday 17, ten 'Few left' slots (08:20 … 10:40, 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40) are shown first, before and outside the 'Morning' heading, mixing morning and afternoon; the 'Morning' block below then starts at 08:00 and contains 09:20. The accessibility tree lists all slots chronologically under 'Morning' and 'Afternoon', so the visual order differs from the reading order.
candidates.impact: A resident looking for 'Saturday morning' may be misled by the first block (which includes afternoon times) or miss that more morning times follow below; keyboard and screen-reader users meet a different order from what sighted helpers see.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: visual order: Few-left block (incl. 13:40-16:40) above 'Morning' heading
DOM order chronological: Morning 08:00, 08:20 Few left, ... 09:20 [pressed] ...

factor_notes.frequency: Every day with 'Few left' slots; Saturday showed ten of 22 free slots in the block.
factor_notes.impact: Slows or misdirects the core choice; mismatch between visual and reading order.

candidates.recommendation: Keep slots in time order inside 'Morning' and 'Afternoon' and mark scarcity on each tile in place.

candidates.title: Permit number field stays visible after choosing Car, without saying it is for vans and trailers only
candidates.description: A field should appear only when it applies, or say when it applies. On /vehicle.html after choosing 'Car', the 'Permit number' field with hint 'Starts DRC-, then five digits.' remains directly below the vehicle buttons. Nothing near it says cars need no permit; the explanation sits behind an icon-only button named 'About vans and trailers'. The booking proceeds with the field left empty.
candidates.impact: A car owner who has never heard of a permit may think they need one, stop to look for it, or phone the council instead of booking.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: Car pressed; Permit number field still shown
textbox "Permit number"; button "About vans and trailers" (icon only)
Next with permit empty proceeds to /confirm.html

factor_notes.frequency: Every car booking, the most common booking.
factor_notes.impact: Creates doubt about eligibility at the moment of choice.

candidates.recommendation: Show the permit field only for 'Car with trailer' and 'Van', or label it 'Permit number (vans and trailers only)'.

candidates.title: No sign of progress for over a second after tapping 'Book this slot'
candidates.description: A submit should be acknowledged at once. On /confirm.html at 375 px, 400 ms and 1.2 s after tapping 'Book this slot' the page is unchanged: same label, no busy text, the button still looks active. The 'Booked' page appears by 3 s.
candidates.impact: A resident may think the tap failed and tap again, or leave the page, unsure whether the slot is booked.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: screenshots b400 and b1200 after click: unchanged confirm page

factor_notes.impact: Uncertainty at the commit step; possible repeat taps (effect of a second tap not probed).

candidates.recommendation: On tap, disable the button and change it to 'Booking…' (announced), until the result loads.

candidates.title: 'Booked' page does not restate the day, time window or vehicle
candidates.description: A booking confirmation should state what was booked. /done.html shows 'Booked', the reference and 'Show this at the gate…', but not Saturday 17 October, 09:20 to 09:40, or the car and registration. The day and window appear only on the previous page.
candidates.impact: A resident who keeps or prints this page as their record, and who does not know they must arrive within the 20-minute slot, may not know when to arrive and may be turned away.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

locations.snippet: Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper

evidence.detail: full page: no day, time or vehicle
main contains only heading Booked, reference region, At the centre region, Book another slot

factor_notes.impact: The page is the artefact read at the gate with poor signal; missing the arrival window risks being turned away.

candidates.recommendation: Show day, 20-minute window ('arrive between 09:20 and 09:40'), vehicle and registration next to the reference.

candidates.title: Nothing on the booking path says the chosen slot is held or for how long
candidates.description: When a choice is held for a limited time, the user should be told the limit. The packet's screen index lists a 'hold=expired' state on /confirm.html, so the hold ends. On the walked path no text mentions a hold or its duration: searched the ARIA snapshots of / after selecting 09:20 (probes/31), /vehicle.html (probes/9) and /confirm.html (probes/15); none contain 'held', 'hold', 'minutes' (other than 'Slots last 20 minutes') or a countdown.
candidates.impact: A resident booking while doing something else (e.g. fetching the registration) may lose the slot without warning, which matters because slots are scarce.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

factor_notes.frequency: Every booking; only harmful when the resident pauses.
factor_notes.impact: Loss of a scarce slot without warning.

candidates.recommendation: After a slot is chosen, state 'We hold 09:20 for you until hh:mm' on each following page, and warn before it ends.
